note: SPOILERS. Phase 4: what each person remembers of the last ranger, from the Phase 4 spoiler addendum. Hints only, each from one point of view; none settles what happened. Read like dialogue.json.

rows.speaker: wren
rows.text: There's a mug on the hook behind the counter. Big, plain, black. Somebody had a large black coffee here at five every morning, once. Then one morning, they didn't.

rows.speaker: rosa
rows.text: The last ranger ate tamales on Fridays and always paid for whoever came in after them. Lonely, I think. A person who pays for strangers is lonely.

rows.speaker: teo
rows.text: The last ranger used to hum something. A tune. I've never been able to place it. I wrote it down, though. Just in case.

rows.speaker: marge
rows.text: The last ranger bought nails. Far more nails than one person needs. 'Building something,' they said. Never said what.

rows.speaker: nell
rows.text: The last ranger told me once that the view from the tower was different at night. I've wanted to climb it ever since.

rows.speaker: agnes
rows.text: The last ranger borrowed every book we have on the park's early days. They brought them all back. Well. All but one.

rows.speaker: bev
rows.text: The last ranger sold me carvings of animals. I didn't recognise a single one. I kept one. It's on the high shelf. Not for sale.

rows.speaker: gus
rows.text: Built the cabin's door for the last ranger. To their pattern. Strange pattern. I still have it.

rows.speaker: sol
rows.text: I never met the last ranger. I have a photograph of them, though, waving from a bridge. I don't know who took it.

rows.speaker: lyle
rows.text: The last ranger? Perfectly ordinary. A thoroughly ordinary person. Highest praise I have.

rows.speaker: esme
rows.text: The last ranger asked better questions than you. You'll catch up.

rows.speaker: pip
rows.text: I met the last ranger when I was five! They showed me a footprint and said, don't tell anyone, they're shy. So I didn't. Except now. And you're a ranger, so it's allowed.
